Founder & Head Chef
Adriano trained under a Michelin-starred chef in Milan and spent 12 years inside European fine dining kitchens where precision was non-negotiable.
He brings an Italian discipline to every menu: clean flavors, exact technique, and the belief that a plate should say only what it needs to say.
After falling in love with Bali in 2018, he founded myCHEF to build a private dining brand that respected local sourcing while holding international standards.
Today he still leads the signature tasting menus, trains the chef team, and takes the bookings where the cooking needs his personal hand.
Chef's Table note
Adriano is available for Chef's Table on Friday and Saturday only, with a maximum of 6 guests.

Indonesian-Mediterranean Fusion

15 years in Bali hospitality and trained at IHTI, Surya specializes in cross-cultural menus that feel polished without losing warmth. He is intuitive with large groups and makes complex villa dinners look effortless.
Warm, intuitive, confident with large groups. Makes cooking look effortless.
Available for:
Villa dinners, events, corporate bookings, groups up to 30
Signature dish: Balinese bebek betutu reimagined for fine dining plating
Book I Made Surya Bayu Pranata Pastry & Dessert Precision

Trained under a French-trained Indonesian chef, Bayu moved to Bali in 2020 and became known for dessert precision. He is methodical, quietly brilliant, and the chef guests remember when the final course lands.
Methodical. Quiet talent. Guests always ask about the dessert.
Available for:
Full villa dinners, pastry consultation, events with dessert stations
Signature dish: Pandan crème brûlée with coconut tuile and mango gel
Book Bayu Pranata Ni Putu Asri Plant-Forward Balinese

Born in Ubud and trained across Indonesia and Singapore, Asri returned to Bali with global technique and deep local ingredient knowledge. Her cooking is creative, grounded, and deeply connected to Bali's food culture.
Creative, grounded, deeply connected to Bali's food culture.
Available for:
Villa dinners, retreats, plant-forward events
Signature dish: Jackfruit rendang with tempeh crust and sambal matah

If you already know whose cooking you want, the process is simple and handled over WhatsApp.
Tell us your date + guest count Message us with your villa area, the dinner style you want, and whether you already have a preferred chef in mind.
We check availability Our team confirms which chefs are open for your date and recommends the closest fit if your first choice is already booked.
Once the deposit is in, we lock your chef, menu direction, and arrival plan for the evening.
FAQ
We will help you choose the right chef, align the menu, and confirm the best fit for your date.

Yes, subject to availability. Tell us who you want when you message and we will check that chef first before suggesting anyone else. What if my preferred chef is unavailable? We will suggest the closest-fit alternative based on menu style and group size, or help you rebook for a date when your preferred chef is available. Is Adriano available for all bookings? No. Adriano is reserved for Chef's Table on Fridays and Saturdays, plus a limited number of 7-course tasting menus and custom collaborations. Are the chefs vetted? Yes. Every myCHEF chef passes a background check, food safety certification review, and in-person skills assessment before leading a booking. Can I meet the chef before booking? Yes. We can arrange a WhatsApp intro call so you can align on style, dietary needs, and the kind of evening you want to host. Reserve your chef
Share your date, guest count, and preferred chef. We confirm quickly and match the right kitchen talent for your villa dinner.
